---
title: "Frequently asked questions"
---

This section contains a collection of common misconceptions, frequently asked questions and concerns around preregistration. It is designed to be used as a reference guide which you can revisit. This collection is organized according to the stages of doing a preregistration.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
